claims.text: Input validation at the boundary: the COMBINED key '*' and the id separator ':' can never be an account key. ACCOUNT_KEY is [a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}, so 'account:line' ids are unique and '*' cannot shadow a real account.
